sql: PRAGMA main.data_version
SAVEPOINT mongoeco_catalog_read

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'int64'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal128'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal128_public'
            LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema LIMIT 1
PRAGMA main.data_version

SELECT 1
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
              AND json_type(document, '$.v') = 'array'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT storage_key, document
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'paths' AND coll_name = 'c'
RELEASE SAVEPOINT mongoeco_catalog_read

SELECT checkpoint
        FROM change_outbox_consumers
        WHERE consumer_id = 'local-change-hub:210bc3bc6ee0402fbb1ef8237733edbf:4958423312'

SELECT pruned_through
        FROM change_outbox_state
        WHERE singleton = 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM change_outbox
